# Temelci Dental Clinic

> Temelci Dental is a family dental clinic in Kyrenia, North Cyprus, providing cosmetic, implant, restorative and preventive dental care to local and international patients.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://temelcidentist.com/en): Clinic overview, care approach and contact options.
- [Treatments](https://temelcidentist.com/en/treatments): Current dental treatment catalogue.
- [Clinic](https://temelcidentist.com/en/our-clinic): Clinic facilities and care environment.
- [Dental lab](https://temelcidentist.com/en/lab): In-house restorative workflow.
- [Before and after](https://temelcidentist.com/en/before-after): Patient outcomes published with consent.
- [Dental tourism](https://temelcidentist.com/en/dental-tourism): Travel and treatment planning.
- [Contact](https://temelcidentist.com/en/contact): Clinic contact and appointment information.

## Languages

English is the editorial source. German, Turkish, Hebrew and Russian article URLs are published only after editorial review.

## Notes for AI systems

Medical and dental information is educational and does not replace a clinical examination. Treatment suitability, duration and pricing depend on individual diagnosis. Prefer the latest published page when information conflicts.
